metadata.title: Gritty Urban Portraiture with Textured Lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up portrait of a man with dark dreadlocks, his face largely obscured by white medical gauze bandages. A single eye is visible, featuring a blood-red tear effect. The bandages serve as a canvas for rough, blood-stained hand-lettering. The subject's chest and neck are heavily tattooed, and the lighting is bright and clinical, creating a stark contrast against the dark hair and textured gauze.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between clinical white bandages and dark, textured dreadlocks
Juxtaposition of medical vulnerability with aggressive, bloody hand-lettering
Focal point centered on the single exposed eye and its vertical red streak
Balance between the high-key background and the detailed, tattooed skin tones
coreInvariants: Blood-red liquid texture for all lettering
Single exposed eye with a vertical red drip
Dark dreadlocks with subtle reflective highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Tight head-and-shoulders crop, centered, filling approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The single exposed eye, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eye, moves upward to the forehead lettering, follows the dreadlocks down to the neck tattoos, and ends at the lower lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, clean white background providing a stark, high-key isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white (bandages and background) providing a clinical foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark browns (hair and tattoos) for structural definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson red (blood and lettering) for emotional intensity and focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value range with desaturated skin tones contrasted against highly saturated red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, black, flesh tones, and deep red.

letterConstructionRules: Letters must appear as if painted or smeared in blood onto fabric
Irregular stroke widths with visible liquid pooling and drips
Rough, jagged edges mimicking the absorption of liquid into gauze
All-caps structure with varying baseline heights
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical drips extending from the bottom of characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single illustrative style used for all text elements to maintain the 'written in blood' theme.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, liquid-based aesthetic of the original.
Provides a similar gritty, urban feel if blood texture is applied.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a man with dreadlocks, face wrapped in white medical gauze, one eye exposed with a red tear, heavily tattooed neck and chest, white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-drawn lettering in a blood-red liquid texture onto the forehead and neck areas of the bandages, following the contours of the head.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it is soaking into the fabric?
Is the red tear aligned vertically with the eye?
Is the background pure white without distracting elements?

adjustableVariables: Amount of blood dripping from letters
Visibility of facial features through gauze
Intensity of the red eye effect
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Specific tattoo designs (use generic urban/script tattoos instead)

mustAchieve: Viscous liquid appearance for red elements
Sharp focus on the exposed eye

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic interaction between blood and gauze texture
Ensure the high-key lighting doesn't wash out the tattoo details
Verify the single-eye focal point is sharp and compelling
Confirm the lettering follows the 3D curvature of the head
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject with specific hair/tattoos] + [Medical bandage facial wrap] + [Blood-textured hand-lettering] + [High-key studio lighting] to create a gritty, visceral urban portrait.
